summary: Five churches in the CCBN family. The weekend, weekday, Confession and Friday Adoration schedule is clear and agrees in the newest bulletins; a new weekday schedule began Oct 12 and replaced the older St. Rose 7 AM and Central Office Chapel (part of Assumption's parcel) Masses. Saturday Confession moved from St. Rose to St. Mark in the Oct 18 issue (R40). Open: whether the 15-minute Adoration opening the CCBN Moms meetings (Nov 4 and Dec 2, Central Office chapel at Assumption) counts, since the audience is a moms' group; leaning out.

sources.said: CCBN MOMS UPCOMING MEETINGS Wednesday, November 4th 6:30pm-8:00pm Assumption Church | CCBN Central Office, 16 Peter St. Adoration will take place in the chapel until 6:45pm
LOCATION: CCBN Central Office, 16 Peter Street ... 6:30 PM: Adoration in the chapel

slots.rationale: R30: POLICY and the rules do not settle whether Adoration that opens a group's meeting counts as public. The location is settled (R21-R23: the Central Office chapel is on Assumption's tax parcel, so it is assumption-buffalo), and date and time are clear (newest bulletin p5: 'Adoration will take place in the chapel until 6:45pm'; the Sep 27 and Oct 4 notices give '6:30 PM: Adoration in the chapel'). But the audience is the CCBN Moms group ('a community meant to bring Catholic moms together'), not the whole parish; C7 does not apply because no heading says the events are open to everyone. Leaning to leave out: POLICY leaves out Masses limited to a group, a wrong listing is worse than a missing one, and the notice invites moms only. Against: anyone may come late or leave early, and the Adoration is in a listed church's chapel.
